description: This file defines the AuthProvider class which manages authentication state, login/logout actions, and current user data for a Flutter application. It interacts with AuthService for authentication operations and uses shared_preferences to persist user info.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that provides authentication state management, including login, logout, and fetching current user info.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes authentication status and user email, notifying listeners of changes.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Attempts to authenticate the user with provided credentials, updates state on success.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user and updates the authentication state.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's profile information from shared preferences.
